sentences.l2: 春から、妹は新しい学校に通うことになった。
sentences.l1: From spring, my younger sister was going to attend a new school.

sentences.l2: そこで、家族で町の商店へ鞄を選びに行った。
sentences.l1: So, my family went to a shop in town to choose a bag.

sentences.l2: 妹は青い鞄が好きだったが、母は「毎日使うから、軽くて丈夫なものが大事だよ」と言った。
sentences.l1: My younger sister liked blue bags, but my mother said, "Because you'll use it every day, a light and sturdy one is what matters."

sentences.l2: 妹は少し考えて、青くて軽い鞄に決めた。
sentences.l1: My younger sister thought a little and decided on a bag that was blue and light.

sentences.l2: 帰り道、妹はとても嬉しそうに鞄を持っていた。
sentences.l1: On the way home, my younger sister was carrying the bag, looking very happy.
